versions.subject: Added a rule to detect the use windows telemetry mechanism for persistence
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetObject|contains|all: 
        - '\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\AppCompatFlags\TelemetryController\'
        - '\Command'
    Details|contains: '.exe'
    EventType: 'SetValue'
filter:
    Details|contains: 
        - '\system32\CompatTelRunner.exe'
        - '\system32\DeviceCensus.exe'
condition: selection and not filter
